conviction_note: Mild positive lean. argenx has beaten revenue consensus by about 7-9% on its last two non-pre-released quarters, and Q3 seasonality (+$178M QoQ in Q3'25 after +$159M in Q2'25) applied to Q2'26's +$219M addition points to roughly $1.72-1.77B of product sales against an aggregator bar of $1.57-1.65B. But that bar is disputed (one aggregator, two figures, and an EPS dispersion of $6.51 to $7.44), and the stock has already rebounded 8% in five sessions off the post-UNITY low, so p_up is held at 56 on an abs_move of 5.5, which gives +0.66. impact_sum +0.9 and impact_scaled +0.66 agree in sign and are of similar size.
bar: Q3 2026 total revenue $1.65B, EPS $7.44 (EarningsWhispers, https://beta.earningswhispers.com/go/x/ARGX, read 2026-10-21). An older EarningsWhispers article gives $1.57B revenue and $7.50 EPS (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/ARGX/2607234019), and HC Wainwright models EPS of $6.51 (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/hc-wainwright-predicts-argenexs-q3-earnings-nasdaqargx-2026-07-27/). A May 2026 model of about $6.5B for FY26 Vyvgart sales (https://ca.investing.com/news/-4646284) would imply an H2 average near $1.85B a quarter, well above a $1.65B Q3. The company gives no revenue guidance (Q2 release https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001697862/000169786226000033/a04earningspressreleasehy.htm). The bar is therefore DISPUTED (one aggregator, two figures), so every finding is capped small. Q2'26 actual: product net sales $1,516M, against a $1.42B consensus (Saxo, https://www.home.saxo/nl-be/content/articles/equities/be-argenx-earnings-q2-review-23072026).
positioning_check: FINRA short interest, via equibles (https://equibles.com/stocks/argx/shortinterest): 1,352,184 shares at 2026-09-30, days to cover 4.94; 1,313,174 at 09-15 (DTC 6.31). That is about 2% of the roughly 61M ADS and NOT crowded. The baseline's 25-delta skew is +2.3 vol points, so downside is modestly paid. Put/call OI is 0.85. The 30-day straddle implies 10.35% at ATM IV 47.5%, and realised 20d vol is 52.7%, so the baseline's event-implied move nets to 0 and cannot be used as a scale. Tape: 5d +8.27% (recovery from about $818 after the 2026-10-08 UNITY futility drop of -11.8%), 20d -6.33%, -16% from the 52-week high. Stocktwits retail sentiment turned 'bullish' around 10-08 (https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/why-is-argx-stock-plunging-today/cZDUKruRBNg).

findings.finding: Q3 seasonality and argenx's beat pattern point to Q3 product net sales near $1.72-1.77B against an aggregator total-revenue bar of $1.57-1.65B. The pattern: Q3'25 added +$178M QoQ (to $1,127M) after Q2'25's +$159M. Q2'26 added +$219M QoQ (to $1,516M, +17%). Q3'25 beat consensus ($1.151B against $1.056B, about +9%) and Q2'26 beat it ($1.516B against $1.42B, about +7%). Repeating even a +$200M Q3 addition gives about $1.72B, roughly 4-10% above the bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3'25 revenue beat (about +9%): stock +5.75% pre-market on 2025-10-30 (https://www.itiger.com/news/1117828768). Q2'26 beat (about +7%): +5% early in Brussels, +8.6% at the day-0 close (baseline row 2026-07-23 +8.56%). Q1'26 ($1.298B, flat QoQ): -2.5% (https://stocktitan.net/news/ARGX/argenx-reports-first-quarter-2026-financial-results-and-provides-d857iu0zibsu.html). Beats on this line have been bought.
findings.why_not_priced: If the street were modelling the usual Q3 step-up, the aggregator bar would sit near $1.75B, not $1.57-1.65B; the bar implies only +4% to +9% QoQ, below every recent sequential add. The October tape has been driven by the UNITY futility news (-11.8%) and its rebound, not by sales expectations. The caveat: this is my extrapolation from company history, not a script series, and the bar itself is disputed.
findings.independence: Two company releases (Q3'25 and Q2'26) give the sequential pattern. Consensus-beat sizes come from separate press (itiger/Stock Track for Q3'25, Saxo for Q2'26). A May 2026 FY26 Vyvgart model of about $6.5B (https://ca.investing.com/news/-4646284) implies a higher H2 run-rate than the $1.65B bar. No IQVIA script data was found.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 is the first full quarter of the all-serotype gMG label (FDA approval 2026-05-08, which adds about 11,000 addressable US patients). On the Q2 call the company said payer policies already covered about 55% of US commercial lives within 10 weeks and most plans were removing serology requirements, and that about 80% of Q2 US prefilled-syringe patients were new to VYVGART. These demand drivers were only partly in Q2 numbers.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Label-driven sales acceleration was the stated driver of the Q2'26 beat, which bought +5% to +8.6%. A separate line-level reaction is not isolable.
findings.why_not_priced: These are public call statements, so they are partly priced. They matter only through the size of the Q3 sequential add, which the low aggregator bar suggests is not fully modelled. If they were priced, the bar would already sit at or above the Q2 sequential pace.
findings.independence: This shares the Q3 sales line with finding 1 but rests on different facts (the label approval and payer coverage, not the seasonal pattern). Sized small for that reason.

findings.finding: Into the print the stock rebounded +8.27% in five sessions, from about $818 (the 2026-10-08 close after the -11.8% UNITY Sjögren's futility drop, and the 10-14 close per biopharmawatch) to $886. It rose +3.4% on the 10-15 call announcement and +0.79% on the 10-19 ALKIVIA ACR late-breaker news. The 25-delta skew is +2.3 (downside modestly paid). Part of a beat is now in the price.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1'26 printed after a flat set-up and fell -2.5%. Q2'26 printed after a run to $851.72 and still rose. No clean pattern.
findings.why_not_priced: This IS the price. It is filed as the offset to the beat thesis: an 8% five-day rebound with no fundamental news beyond a conference slot means part of the expected beat is already paid for. Short interest is not crowded (about 2% of shares, DTC 4.9), so no squeeze mechanism amplifies it.
findings.independence: The baseline tape (run_up_5d_pct 8.27, skew +2.3), separately computed: /home/user/claude_research/research/2026/10/2026-10-21/edge-panel/baselines/ARGX.json

findings.finding: argenx closed the $2.2B cash acquisition of Forte Biosciences (FB102) on 2026-08-27, inside Q3. Cash ($5.2B at 06-30) drops by about $2.2B. argenx reports under IFRS, where an asset acquisition's IPR&D is capitalised rather than expensed, so the EPS hit should be limited. A remeasurement of argenx's pre-existing Forte stake and added FB102 R&D are possible below-the-line or opex noise against the $7.44 EPS bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No precedent acquisition of this size in argenx's recent prints.
findings.why_not_priced: The deal is public. What is not visible is how it is accounted for in Q3 (capitalised IPR&D or business combination, any stake remeasurement, deal costs). Aggregator EPS ranges ($6.51-$7.44) suggest models differ. It sits below operating income with no path to a guide, so it is sized at a fraction.
findings.independence: The tender-offer filing gives the closing and argenx's pre-existing stake: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001419041/000114036126034554/ny20080629x2_exa5vi.htm. The IFRS treatment is my inference from argenx's IFRS reporting terms in the Q2 release ('profit for the period', 'current financial assets').

findings.finding: The business update can carry pipeline news inside the window. EMPASSION (empasiprubart against IVIg in MMN) topline is guided for 4Q26 and has not been reported as of 2026-10-21; the Phase 2 ARDA study cut IVIg rescue need by 84-91%. A Q3 release could also add UNITY (Sjögren's) data detail after the 10-08 futility stop, and the planned ocular MG sBLA filing (guided 'by end of Q3 2026'). EMPASSION landing in the release is a low-probability, binary, positively skewed item.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Registrational readouts moved the stock hard: ALKIVIA positive on 2026-08-17 +16.0%; UNITY futility on 2026-10-08 -11.8%.
findings.why_not_priced: The timing is not dated within Q4, so the market cannot price whether it lands tomorrow. With a 10.35% 30-day straddle the option market carries general event vol, not this specific binary. Expected value near zero; the item mainly widens the move.
findings.independence: UNITY stop: https://finviz.com/news/400131/argenx-provides-update-on-phase-3-unity-study-of-efgartigimod-sc-in-sjogrens-disease (2026-10-08). The search for EMPASSION topline found nothing published.
